title: Delete Node in a BST (Inorder Successor)

monster.name: BST Pruning Wight
monster.title: Rebalancer of Severed Branches
monster.defeatQuote: Replacing with the inorder successor preserved the BST property!

description: Given an array of integers representing a BST in sorted order (inorder traversal), simulate deleting the node with value `key` and return the remaining BST inorder array.
starterCode:
def deleteNodeBST(inorder: list[int], key: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def deleteNodeBST(inorder: list[int], key: int) -> list[int]:
    return [x for x in inorder if x != key]
hints: In a BST, deletion replaces a node with 2 children with its inorder successor.
